mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to correlate with subsequent 60d SPX returns (Pearson's r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in UNRATE, indicating a strengthening labor market, increase consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with consecutive UNRATE declines, or the labor market's influence on SPX returns becomes insignificant (p > 0.1) in a walk-forward regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased industrial production, supply chain pressures may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: The signal's walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly correlated with INDPRO's deviation from its 6-month MA (Spearman's ρ < 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of increasing RSAFS and decreasing UNRATE signals robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term in a walk-forward regression analysis becomes insignificant (p > 0.05), or SPX returns fail to correlate with the combined RSAFS and UNRATE signal (Pearson's r < 0.25).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% in a monetary easing cycle, coupled with a concurrent increase in PAYEMS, amplifies the positive impact on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term's coefficient in a walk-forward regression analysis becomes negative or insignificant (p > 0.1), or the combined signal's Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating housing market strength, coupled with low UNRATE, drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: The signal's walk-forward performance in late-cycle expansions is not significantly better than in other regimes (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction's influence on SPX returns becomes insignificant (p > 0.1) in a walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in CPIAUCSL, signaling rising inflation expectations, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this effect is muted in monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: The signal's performance in non-tightening cycles is not significantly different from tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.1), or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
